items.title: Walter Booker and Jimmy Cobb interviewed by Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 30, 1995
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Mr. Murray's Dance Casino' and asks if the interviewee used to go there; the interviewee confirms 'Yeah. We used to play' but does not describe a personal relationship with Mr. Murray himself.

ctx.x: Well you know I really can’t add very much except I was into listening to a lot of bass players, even though I wanted to play other instruments before I started playing the bass. I can’t add very much to it because I’m just a little bit behind him in years, and we were from Washington. So I was exposed to the same thing almost at the same time, you know? Except there was Mr. Murray’s Dance Casino, which was down the street from where he’s talking about, also added to that. I think I remember him telling me he…
Yeah. We used to play, but I think I can remember working some place, working for $5 a night and the guy owed me $85 after a while.
